claim: Live FL Europe store-locator census 2026-10-07: 403 stores in six western markets (Italy 154, France 140, Spain 46, Portugal 9, UK 49, Ireland 5). The same method on all 14 European locator subdomains gives 555 (DE 79, NL 22, BE 15, AT 6, LU 6, PL 12, CZ 9, HU 3), against DKS's 559 Europe owned stores at 8/1/26.
data_point: IT 154, FR 140, ES 46, PT 9, UK 49, IE 5 = 403; 14-domain total 555; IT+FR = 294 (53%)
source_name: Foot Locker Europe store locator sitemaps (RioSEO), stores.footlocker.<cc>/sitemap.xml
verifier_note: Independently re-downloaded all 14 live sitemaps on 2026-10-07 and de-duplicated by store number: exact match (403 / 555). Store IDs can be 4 digits (e.g. Mulhouse Porte Jeune 5388), so a 5-digit-only regex undercounts FR and AT by one each. Baseline BL01/BL06 confirm DKS and FL never disclosed per-country counts, so this is novel. Caveats: locator dated 2026-10-07 vs DKS 8/1/26; DK/SE/NO/CH stores have no locator subdomain and are not in the 555, so the locator probably carries more stores than DKS's owned count, which fits the lag finding. Primer says Europe = 15 countries.

verifier_note: Re-fetched 10 archived sitemaps directly from Wayback (UK 2022-07-25 = 59, 2025-11-09 = 53; FR 2025-11-11 = 145, 2026-04-02 = 141; IT 2022-07-09 = 161, 2025-05-22 = 159; ES 2024-07-03 = 50; PT 2026-01-12 = 10; IE 2024-01-17 = 7, 2026-02-08 = 5): all match. Caveats: (1) the 'deal-close' base is really Nov-25 for UK/FR, May-25 for IT and Jul-24 for ES, since there is no ES snapshot after Jul-24; (2) the net run-rate (~3.4%/yr) is IN LINE with the known ~4%/yr Europe run-rate (KNOWN_BRIEF), not above it. Only the gross rate and the UK/PT figures are faster. The per-country series is novel.

claim: France: Avignon 9 rue des Marchands (05107), described as FL's first store in France, closed permanently 2026-09-15. Its four employees were moved to other FL stores. FL keeps Mistral 7 and Aushopping Avignon Nord. The store is still on the locator (HTTP 200) on 2026-10-07.
data_point: Closure 2026-09-15; 4 staff redeployed; still listed on the locator 3 weeks later
source_name: Le Mag Avignon (Eloise Veyrenc), citing ledauphine.com
original_quote: Foot Locker fermera définitivement sa boutique du centre-ville d'Avignon mardi 15 septembre, selon ledauphine.com.
english_translation: Foot Locker will permanently close its Avignon city-centre shop on Tuesday 15 September, according to ledauphine.com.
verifier_note: Article fetched: dated 2026-09-11, author Eloise Veyrenc. Quote, 4 staff kept, 'first French store (per employees)' and the remaining Mistral 7 and Aushopping stores all verified. The article frames the closure as part of FL's 2023 plan ('Le groupe avait alors prévu de fermer 400 boutiques d'ici à 2026'), not a DKS exit. Le Dauphine could not be fetched (blocked). The live locator page 05107 returns 200, which confirms the lag. SIRENE still shows the Avignon establishment (38240186700074) as active, so the registry lags as well.

claim: The FL Europe locator lags real closures by 3 weeks to 8+ months and posts no closure notices. Locator-based counts therefore overstate open stores, and closure counts from it are a floor.
data_point: GranCasa closed Jun-25 but listed to ~Feb-26; Chartres closed 2025-06-15, still in the Nov-25 sitemap; Lille Euralille Kids SIRENE-closed 2025-08-16, listed to Apr-26; Avignon closed 2026-09-15, still live 2026-10-07
source_name: Locator vs press and SIRENE cross-check
verifier_note: Verified: Avignon page returns HTTP 200 on 2026-10-07 after the confirmed 2026-09-15 closure; Chartres SIRENE closure 2025-06-15 vs presence in the Nov-25 sitemap. Verifier found an extra case: Euralille SIRENE closure 2025-08-16 vs 65118 still in the Apr-26 sitemap. The GranCasa 2026-02-14 page capture and the 403-page closure-flag scan were not independently re-run. Inference: the 555 locator total (which also excludes DK/SE/NO/CH) is consistent with true Europe owned stores now being below 559. Method caveat, tier B.

New: UK Telford (04314) and Liverpool ONE (04448); FR CC Neyrpic (05342) and Forum des Halles Porte Berger (05377); IT Taranto (06532) and Orio Center 1.19 (06199); ES Diagonal Mar (17183), Siam Mall Adeje (17502) and El Mirador (17568). Refit and relocation re-codes: Aprilia 06401->06601, Casamassima 06393->06493, Bolzano 06143->06400.
data_point: ~7-9 openings, relistings or relocations vs ~21 closures in the six markets
verifier_note: All the listed new IDs are present live and absent from the latest Wayback sitemap for each country (UK Nov-25, FR Apr-26, IT May-25, ES Jul-24). Re-code pairs are matched by the scraper by address and were not individually re-verified. Context: DKS already discloses Europe +4 new (Sep-25 to Jan-26) and +2 new (Feb to Jul-26), so the fact of openings is known in aggregate. The named list and the refit/relocation re-codes are new. The Bullring 04266->04366 item was not verified. Tier B.
